value.rationale: The exact all-field distribution of ambiguity multiplicities for the natural permutation-only Reed–Solomon decoding boundary is a complete structural classification; it also determines the sharp first usable alphabet q=8 and enumerates every suitable three-point evaluation set. It is neither a restatement of general long-code asymptotics nor a single arbitrary parameter slice; the limitation to n=3,k=2 is forced by the first possible nontrivial unordered evaluation channel.
